Title: Patient already has an active modality

Step Action: Log into the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Click on “Accept” button
At the top in the “-Select a patient-“ listbox, select patient 1018
On the main menu select “Modality”
We see that patient already has an active Modality
Click on “New” menu option
Warning: Patient already has an active Modality
Click on “OK” pop-up button
The system shall not allow the user to create a new Modality
Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1050 with the patients searching option
Click on "Modality" button in the main menu
Click on "New" button
Complete the necessary data:

- Clinical status
- Modality
- Sub-modality
- Location
- Attendance type
- System
- Start date
- Referred by
- Reason for start
- End date
- Reason for end
- Detail
Click on "Cancel" button
The system shall not save the new Modality
Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1050 with the patients searching option
Click on "Modality" button in the main menu
Click on "New" button
Complete the necessary data:

- Clinical status
- Modality
- Sub-modality
- Location
- Attendance type
- System
- Start date
- Referred by
- Reason for start
- End date
- Reason for end
- Detail
Click on "Save" button
The system shall save the new Modality and must be listed first depending on the date

Title: Add Modality with empty required fields

Step Action: Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1050 with the patients searching option
Click on "Modality" button in the main menu
Click on "New" button
Leave the required fields empty:

- Clinical status
- Modality
- Sub-modality
- Start date
Click on "Save" button
Warning: these fields are required
Click on "OK" pop-up button
The system shall not allow to save the new Modality
